description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a server manager simulation for testing purposes. It includes functions to retrieve environment variables, configure server parameters, and runs a test HTTP server with detailed instructions printed to stderr.

classes.name: ServerManagerConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for server manager, encapsulating environment variables, preloaded server count, session server path, and startup timeout.

classes.name: TestService
classes.description: A test HTTP server providing control and status endpoints for the server manager simulation.

methods.name: getSessionServerPath
methods.description: Retrieves the session server path from environment variable or defaults to '/usr/bin/RialtoServer'.

methods.name: getStartupTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the startup timeout from environment variable or defaults to zero milliseconds.

methods.name: getEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Parses environment variables from a semicolon-separated string in environment variable 'SESSION_SERVER_ENV_VARS'.

methods.name: getNumberOfPreloadedServers
methods.description: Retrieves the number of preloaded servers from environment variable 'RIALTO_PRELOADED_SERVERS'.
